description: Focused projection of the three SDDC Manager operations needed to precheck a host commission and then, only if the precheck passes, commission the hosts.

specSource.infoTitle: VMware Cloud Foundation API Reference Guide

operations.summary: Perform validation of the  HostCommissionSpec specification
Retrieve the results of a host commission validation by its ID

excludedOperations.reason: Marked deprecated at tag 9.0.0.0. validateHostCommissionSpec is the supported precheck for this workflow, so this route is outside the contract and is not served.

HostCommissionSpec.description: This specification contains the input to commission a host to VMware Cloud Foundation

storageType.example: One among: VSAN, VSAN_ESA, VSAN_REMOTE, VSAN_MAX, NFS, VMFS_FC, VVOL, VMFS

networkPoolId.description: ID of the network pool to associate the host with

networkPoolName.description: Name of the network pool to associate the host with

Validation.description: Represents a validation with a list of one or more validation checks that are performed as part of the validation

executionStatus.description: Execution status of the validation. One among: IN_PROGRESS, FAILED, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN, SKIPPED, CANCELLED, CANCELLATION_IN_PROGRESS

resultStatus.description: Result status of the validation after it has completed its execution. One among: SUCCEEDED, FAILED, WARNING, UNKNOWN, CANCELLATION_IN_PROGRESS
Result status of the validation check after it has completed its execution

acknowledge.description: Flag indicating whether the validation check requires acknowledgment

type.description: Operation that is represented by the Task in machine readable format.

referenceToken.description: A referenceToken to publish in the error message

precheckGate.rule: commissionHosts may be sent only after a validation reaches executionStatus COMPLETED with resultStatus SUCCEEDED. Any other terminal outcome - including resultStatus WARNING - leaves the gate closed, and no request may reach POST /v1/hosts.

wireRules.requestBodyIsArray: Both validateHostCommissionSpec and commissionHosts take a JSON array of HostCommissionSpec, even when a single host is supplied. A bare object is not a valid body.
wireRules.omitUnsetOptionalProperties: Every HostCommissionSpec property the caller did not supply must be absent from the encoded object. Never send it as null, as an empty string, or as any other placeholder.
wireRules.requiredPropertiesAlwaysPresent: fqdn, username, password, storageType and networkPoolId are required by the schema and always appear.
wireRules.noAdditionalProperties: No property outside the HostCommissionSpec schema may appear on the wire.
wireRules.propertyOrderIsNotSignificant: The set of properties present is what matters; their order within an object is not constrained.
wireRules.headerValuesAreExact: A request that carries a body sends Content-Type: application/json exactly, with no charset parameter. Every request sends Accept: application/json. A request without a body sends no Content-Type header.
wireRules.noQueryParameters: None of the three operations declares a query parameter, so no request may carry a query string.
wireRules.pathParameterComesFromTheServer: The {id} segment of getHostCommissionValidationByID is the id returned by the preceding validateHostCommissionSpec response, not a value chosen by the client.

serverBehaviourInThisSeed.baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port>, bound to the loopback interface only
serverBehaviourInThisSeed.routing: The mock builds its routing table from the operations array above. Any other method or path is answered 404 with an Error body and is still recorded in the request log.
serverBehaviourInThisSeed.requestLog: Every exchange is appended as one JSON object per line to the request log file the test hands to the mock.
